source.source_name: RNE — Registre National des Entreprises (Data INPI)
source.license: Open data (INPI conditions of reuse); RBE restricted
source.attribution: Source: INPI, Registre National des Entreprises.

access.note: Free account on data.inpi.fr issues SFTP + API credentials. Do not bypass auth; provision creds via env.

pagination.note: Bulk = daily JSON archives over SFTP (full stock + diffs). RNE API = per-SIREN/token. Confirm exact SFTP layout from account docs.

snapshot.note: Persist raw JSON. Exact nested paths vary by personne morale/physique and formality version.

parsing.notes: Nested JSON; branch on personneMorale vs personnePhysique. montantCapital is register capital (EUR; capitalVariable possible). beneficiairesEffectifs is RESTRICTED — do not ingest as open. représentants are PII.

mapping_rules.beneficial_owners: PLANNING-ONLY (restricted) — do not populate from the open feed.

live_test_plan.smoke: With INPI creds, fetch one company via the RNE API; assert siren + denomination + montantCapital parse.
live_test_plan.full: Behind cred env gate, pull the SFTP daily JSON stock + diffs; parse per-company; join to the Sirene spine on siren; route comptesAnnuels to inpi_comptes_annuels.

blockers: Beneficial ownership (RBE) restricted — exclude from open ingestion.
Nested JSON paths must be confirmed against live records.
